load_spearmanr_metric: load the spearmanr metric from the Hugging Face evaluate library
launch_gradio_widget: launch a gradio widget for the spearmanr evaluation metric
run_spearmanr_metric: run the spearmanr metric to compute Spearman rank correlation between predictions and references
evaluate_predictions: evaluate predictions against reference values using the spearmanr correlation metric
test_spearmanr_metric: test the spearmanr metric with sample predictions and reference arrays
